result:
Committed as one commit on the branch, tree clean. Here is the report.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/services/agentcore/runtime.py` — added `list_runtime_versions` / `list_runtime_endpoints` (explicit client, all `nextToken` pages).
- `backend/app/services/agentcore/harness.py` — added `list_harness_versions` / `list_harness_endpoints` (same shape; harness summaries use `updatedAt`, no description).
- `backend/app/services/agent_versions.py` — new: resource-kind resolution, `agent.no_resource` 409 with human reasons, allow-listed projection, version sort (newest first), DEFAULT-first endpoint sort, `latest_version` / `ledger_version` / `canary_endpoints`.
- `backend/app/routers/agents.py` — new `GET /agents/{agent_id}/versions` reusing the workspace-scoped `_agent_in` lookup.
- `backend/app/core/route_policy.py` — registered the GET as `MEMBER`, same posture as `GET /agents/{agent_id}`.
- `backend/tests/test_agent_versions.py` — 16 hermetic tests with a scripted stub control client.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `AgentVersionsInfo` / row types and `api.agentVersions`.
- `frontend/src/components/VersionsPanel.tsx` — new panel: loading / error (`LoadError` with retry) / no-resource note / empty / ready states; DEFAULT and canary tags, ledger-vs-latest mismatch chip, read-only hint.
- `frontend/src/components/index.ts` — export.
- `frontend/src/pages/CreateAgent.tsx` — mounts the panel in step 3 when `detailsMode` is on, above the conversion and KB panels.
- `frontend/src/locales/en/common.json`, `zh-CN/common.json` — `create.versions.*` keys (27 each).
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — Runtime/Harness rows, new "Versions and endpoints (read-only)" subsection, invoke-chain sentence anchored to the panel.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — new "Console Agents API — versions and endpoints" section with response shape and error codes.

## 2. Verified

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -q -k versions` | 16 passed |
| `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_route_policy.py tests/test_client_funnel.py -q` | 410 passed |
| `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint` | clean (one pre-existing warning in EvaluationExperiment.tsx) |
| `python3 scripts/i18n_check.py` / `i18n_zh_punct.py --check` | PASS / OK |
| Headless render probe (esbuild bundle + global Playwright, routes stubbed) | 10/10 scenarios (5 states × en/zh-CN) as expected |
| `make verify` | PASS |

Probe artifacts (screenshots, `probe-results.json`, scripts) are in `/home/ubuntu/workspace/agentcore_launchpad/.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-010/`.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `pytest -k versions`: runtime agent (zip_runtime/studio/container parametrized) calls both runtime ops on the runtime id across two `nextToken` pages; projection asserted key-for-key and a recursive key walk proves no `environmentVariables`/`roleArn`/`agentRuntimeArtifact`/`authorizerConfiguration`/ARNs survive; harness agent → harness ops; discovered harness row → harness ops; discovered row without `resource_type` → runtime ops; deploying/failed/deleted/unresolvable rows → 409 `agent.no_resource` with no AWS call; other-workspace agent → 404 `agent.not_found`.
- ✅ `test_route_policy.py` + `test_client_funnel.py` pass (410 tests).
- ✅ Frontend: probe confirms loading text, `LoadError` with retry on 502, no-resource note on 409, empty-list copy, DEFAULT row tagged (`data-default="true"` + "DEFAULT ENDPOINT" chip), ledger-vs-latest MISMATCH chip and hint when v2 ≠ v3, IN SYNC when equal, canary note + CANARY tags for `stable`/`treatment`; tsc, lint, both i18n scripts clean.
- ✅ `docs/api.md` + `docs/api.zh-CN.md` document the route; `docs/architecture.md` + `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` updated (rows + subsection + invoke-chain anchor).
- ✅ `make verify` PASS in this worktree.
- ✅ Live AWS: **not exercised**, per the brief. Botocore model shapes were verified offline for all four operations.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Response carries two extra fields** beyond the brief's shape: `resource_id` (so the panel can show which AWS resource it read) and `canary_endpoints` (backend-derived list of `stable`/`treatment` names present, so the flag logic lives in one place). Everything listed in the brief is present.
- **Harness versions**: `description` is always `null` because `HarnessVersionSummary` has no such member; `last_updated_at` comes from `updatedAt` (falls back to `createdAt`).
- **Deleted agents** answer 409 `agent.no_resource` ("deleted; its AWS resource is gone") rather than 404, since the sibling `GET /agents/{id}` still serves deleted rows.
- **No frontend unit test** was added: the repo has no vitest/RTL tooling, so the render evidence is the Playwright probe in the runs directory rather than a checked-in test.
- `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` has no discovery section, so the zh-CN subsection was placed after the invoke chain (调用链), together with a translation of the session-pinning sentence that the zh-CN doc lacked.
